title: RootNullInferredWrapperNullable
$comment: The acceptance control for root_null_inferred_wrapper.json: the same wrapper with a {"type":"null"} branch added, so the disjunction admits a null and the wrapper must go on storing it raw. The third branch is what keeps this a wrapper at all -- a two-branch anyOf of one type and null is taken by the nullable-alias arm instead, which produces a pointer with no Validate and could not have failed either way.
